statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient presents with transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The service is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
The diagnoses are R55 and G45.9
The denial reason is CO-197 (required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered)
